purpose: Sensitivity-only normalization that compares broad Korean IPA outputs with predictable narrow allophone variants in phonetic corpus annotations. It is not an adjudicated pronunciation standard and must never replace strict scoring.
preserves: sibilant place contrast among s, ɕ and ʃ
known_feature_losses: fricative aspiration is removed after s, ɕ and ʃ; stop aspiration is retained
retroflex and palatal lateral distinctions are collapsed to l
palatal nasal ɲ is collapsed to n
voicing/place/manner distinctions among several h-like realizations are collapsed to h
selected segmental quality diacritics are removed
syllable and word separators are removed
limitations: This profile is a research-only sensitivity analysis, not a normative IPA gold convention.
It intentionally does not merge s with ɕ or ʃ; a separate, independently adjudicated sibilant policy is required.
A high exact score under this profile does not establish narrow phonetic accuracy or Ukrainian target quality.
